prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1099; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Upon arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I found a two-vehicle rear-end collision. Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane when the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 1's car. Driver 2 stated that they looked away from the road briefly and did not notice the stopped traffic in time. Driver 1 was in the driver's seat at the time of impact, and both I and two independent witnesses confirmed this. Passenger was seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the left shoulder and was evaluated by EMS at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the force of a collision of this kind. The rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamps of Driver 1's vehicle show damage that matches the impact described. I observed no earlier damage to either vehicle, and none was reported. The witness statements and scene photographs agree with the account given by Driver 2. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy presented at the scene.
